title: Rollback-first Staging Timeline — compact flow for rapid triage and emergency revert
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Goal: Design a compact, rollback-first staging timeline for the Redwood Console that surfaces urgent rollback controls, a lightweight triage checklist, and a confidence-band visualizer for canary phases. This flow should prioritize speed and clarity during incidents: engineers and on-call product owners should be able to assess impact, trigger an emergency revert, or schedule a targeted traffic shrink without navigating away from the staging timeline. Deliverables: (1) clickable Figma prototype for the compact timeline (desktop + tablet), (2) handoff tokens and a microcopy set for labels/alerts, (3) annotated interaction spec for engineering (keyboard shortcuts, aria hints, confirm patterns), and (4) a short walkthrough recording for internal runbooks. Constraints: must reuse existing console tokens and integrate with rollout state machine endpoints (ENG dependency). Must support multi-variant A/B and shadow routes. Success metrics: reduce mean time-to-revert (MTTR) for rollbacks by 30% in internal simulated drills; >90% of participants can complete revert in under 60s in usability test.
acceptance_criteria: Clickable Figma prototype (compact timeline) with canary lane expand/collapse and single-click revert
Annotated spec with API call mapping and error states for offline/latency scenarios
Microcopy approved by PM and Engineering and accessible contrast for alerts
Usability test script and results from at least 6 platform engineers or SREs
